# Substation Feeder Commissioning and Insulation Resistance Report
Facility: Ridgefield Cold Storage Unit 4
Date: 04/14/2026
Lead Electrician: Marcus Vance (License #EL-40912)

## Equipment Under Test
- Switchgear Unit: Square-D MasterPact 480V/2000A Main Lineup
- Circuit Designation: Feeder 3B to Evaporator Compressor Bank 2
- Test Equipment: Megger MIT515 5kV Insulation Tester, Fluke 376 FC True-RMS Clamp Meter, Fluke 1587 FC Insulation Multimeter

## Insulation Resistance Test Data (1000V DC Applied for 1 Minute)
| Conductor / Phase | Measured Resistance (MΩ) | Minimum Acceptable (MΩ) | Test Instrument |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phase A to Ground | 420 | 100 | Megger MIT515 |
| Phase B to Ground | 390 | 100 | Megger MIT515 |
| Phase C to Ground | 410 | 100 | Megger MIT515 |
| Neutral to Ground | 280 | 100 | Megger MIT515 |

## Full Load Current Measurements (480V Three-Phase Under Load)
| Phase Leg | Running Amperes (A) |
| --- | --- |
| Phase A | 142.5 |
| Phase B | 148.0 |
| Phase C | 145.5 |

## Field Observations and Analysis
- Technicians conducted insulation resistance testing at 1000V DC and verified all conductors met or exceeded the 100 MΩ threshold.
- Three-phase current unbalance was evaluated using maximum deviation from the average phase current of 145.3 A.
- The total connected three-phase load current across all three phases summed to 446.0 A during peak cycle.
- Phase B phase-to-ground insulation resistance tested at 590 MΩ showing strong dielectric integrity.
- Feeder 3B is cleared for continuous operational duty.
